{"claims":[{"claim_text":"There is no greater threat to American security than the possibility of terrorists armed with weapons of mass destruction.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Preventing terrorists from gaining access to weapons of mass destruction must be America's number one security goal.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"American leadership is required to contain the threat of weapons of mass destruction.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Containing the threat of weapons of mass destruction requires greater collaboration and participation from allies, friends, and partners.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Containing the threat of weapons of mass destruction compels problem states to join and comply with international agreements and abandon their weapons programs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"This Administration's policies have weakened international agreements and efforts to enforce non-proliferation.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"This Administration has not done nearly enough to secure existing stockpiles and bomb-making materials.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"This Administration has failed to take effective steps to stop the North Korean and Iranian nuclear programs.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A change in course is necessary now.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
